_comment: TD-05 reviewed bridge manifest. Changes here need the same review as an API change: an entry added to silence the audit is a bridge regression in disguise. Each allowlist entry states why the asymmetry is intentional and must remain true.
_syntheticRpcPrefixReason: The worker proxies the four synthAudio entry points under an underscore-prefixed RPC name because the worker returns an iterator function pointer that the helper wraps, rather than the raw native result. '_synthAudio' therefore resolves against native 'synthAudio'.

controlPlaneRpcTargets.ready: Worker readiness handshake; not a Score method.
controlPlaneRpcTargets.load: Module-level score load, called before any Score instance exists.
controlPlaneRpcTargets.processSynth: Worker-side pump for a synthAudio iterator; no native export of its own.
controlPlaneRpcTargets.processSynthBatch: Worker-side pump for a batched synthAudio iterator; no native export of its own.

jsImplementedRpcTargets.getExcerptId: Pure JS state on the main-thread score object (this.excerptId); no native call.
jsImplementedRpcTargets.setExcerptId: Pure JS state on the main-thread score object (this.excerptId); no native call.
jsImplementedRpcTargets.metadata: JSON.parse over the native saveMetadata result; no native export of its own.
jsImplementedRpcTargets.measurePositions: JSON.parse over the native savePositions(false) result; no native export of its own.
jsImplementedRpcTargets.segmentPositions: JSON.parse over the native savePositions(true) result; no native export of its own.
jsImplementedRpcTargets.titleFilenameSafe: Sanitizes the native title() result in JS; no native export of its own.
jsImplementedRpcTargets.setSoundFont: Per-score method delegating to the module-level WebMscore.setSoundFont; the native export is module-level, not score-level.

_typescriptOnlyMembersReason: Members of the Score interface that intentionally have no bridge implementation. Should normally be empty: a declared method with no worker proxy is exactly the silent failure TD-05 exists to catch.
